name: Dampier to Bunbury Pipeline
description: WA's principal gas transmission trunk line, running from the North West Shelf at Dampier south through Perth to Bunbury.

name: Parmelia Gas Pipeline
description: Parallel trunk line running from the Mondarra storage facility near Dongara down through Perth to Pinjarra, historically a separate line from the DBP, now operating as part of the integrated WA network.

name: Goldfields Gas Pipeline
description: Carries Pilbara gas from Yarraloola south-east to the Goldfields mining region at Kalgoorlie. Newman is served via a separate 47km lateral spur, not a through-point on the mainline.

name: Pilbara Pipeline System
description: Regional pipeline network distributing Pilbara gas between Dampier and Port Hedland.

name: Telfer Gas Pipeline
description: Lateral pipeline supplying the remote Telfer mine from the Pilbara network at Port Hedland.

name: Mid West Pipeline
description: Connects Geraldton and the Windimurra vanadium mine into the Dampier to Bunbury Pipeline network.

name: Eastern Goldfields Pipeline System
description: Extends gas supply beyond the Goldfields Gas Pipeline terminus at Kalgoorlie south to Kambalda and Esperance.

name: Northern Goldfields Interconnect
description: Real interconnect linking the Goldfields Gas Pipeline (near Leinster/Leonora) directly through to the Dampier to Bunbury Pipeline (near Dongara), commissioned 2023.

name: Kalgoorlie-Kambalda Pipeline
description: Short lateral linking Kalgoorlie to the Kambalda mining area.

name: Kambalda Esperance Gas Pipeline
description: Extends supply from Kambalda south to the port of Esperance.

name: Wheatstone Lateral
description: Connects the Wheatstone LNG/domestic gas plant into the Dampier hub area.

name: Gorgon Lateral
description: Connects the Gorgon LNG/domestic gas plant into the Dampier hub area.

name: Neerabup Lateral
description: Lateral off the DBP trunk supplying the Neerabup industrial and power generation precinct north of Perth.

name: Mandurah Lateral
description: Lateral off the DBP trunk supplying the Mandurah coastal demand centre south of Perth.

name: East Perth Lateral
description: Lateral off the DBP trunk supplying Perth's eastern industrial and power generation corridor.

name: Kemerton Lateral
description: Lateral supplying the Kemerton Strategic Industrial Area near Bunbury.

name: Mt Newman Lateral
description: 47km spur off the Goldfields Gas Pipeline (GGP) mainline serving the Newman mining town.
